# Synthetic fixtures

Every file here is hand-written test data shaped like the responses Treg's
public catalog routes and authenticated read routes return. None is copied
from Treg, its catalog, its OpenAPI document or a provider's example
response. Hosts are `example.com`, emails are `@example.com`, and every id,
call reference, amount and name is made up.

Field names and nesting follow Treg's documented and source-observed shapes,
as interoperability facts; values are invented.
